meta.name: video-ad-specs
meta.description: Video ad creation with exact platform-specific specs for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn. Covers dimensions, duration limits, AIDA framework, and caption requirements. Use for: video ads, social media ads, paid media creative, video marketing, ad production. Triggers: video ad, social media ad, tiktok ad, instagram ad, youtube ad, facebook ad, linkedin ad, video creative, ad specs, paid media, video marketing, ad production, reels ad, stories ad, pre roll, bumper ad

copy.tagline: 按各平台规格创建视频广告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为不同社交媒体平台制作符合规格的视频广告。
copy.tagline_en: Create video ads with platform-specific specs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create video ads that meet exact specs for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据平台规格（TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、Facebook、LinkedIn）生成视频广告，包括尺寸、时长、AIDA 框架和字幕要求。
howto.when: 当你提到“视频广告”、“社交媒体广告”、“TikTok 广告”等关键词，或要求制作特定平台的视频广告时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 TikTok 竖屏视频广告，时长 15 秒。
生成一个 YouTube 6 秒 bumper 广告的脚本。
say.note: Claude 会输出 6 秒非跳过广告的文案和视觉建议。

say.text: 为 Facebook 信息流广告添加字幕。
say.note: Claude 会指导生成字幕文件并合并到视频中。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate video ads with platform-specific specs (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn), covering dimensions, duration limits, AIDA framework, and caption requirements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "video ad", "social media ad", "TikTok ad", or ask to create a video ad for a specific platform.

say_en.text: Create a 15-second vertical video ad for TikTok.
say_en.note: Claude will provide specs and generation commands.

say_en.text: Generate a script for a YouTube 6-second bumper ad.
say_en.note: Claude will output copy and visual suggestions.

say_en.text: Add captions to a Facebook feed video ad.
say_en.note: Claude will guide caption generation and merging.
